target.name: target_flood_exposure
target.description: Indicates whether a road segment intersects an active riverine flood hazard corridor (within 2,500m of an overflowing CWC river gauging reach). Does NOT imply confirmed direct pavement submergence, road closure, or traffic accident.

candidate_features.name: rainfall_24h_mm
candidate_features.derivation: Precipitation accumulated during the 24 hours up to observation time at road centroid

candidate_features.name: rainfall_72h_mm
candidate_features.derivation: Cumulative precipitation accumulated during the 72 hours (3 days) up to observation date at road centroid

candidate_features.name: rainfall_7d_mm
candidate_features.derivation: Cumulative precipitation accumulated during the 7 days up to observation date at road centroid

candidate_features.name: temperature_c
candidate_features.real_time_source: Open-Meteo Real-Time Weather API / In-Vehicle OAT Sensor
candidate_features.derivation: Daily mean surface air temperature at 2m above ground

candidate_features.name: wind_speed_kmh
candidate_features.derivation: Daily maximum wind speed at 10m above ground

candidate_features.name: upstream_rainfall_72h_mm
candidate_features.historical_source: Open-Meteo Historical Archive (ERA5 Reanalysis) at upstream gauge coordinate
candidate_features.real_time_source: Open-Meteo Forecast API queried at upstream catchment inlet
candidate_features.derivation: Cumulative precipitation over the 72 hours preceding observation date at the upstream hydrological inlet/gauge

candidate_features.name: catchment_mean_rainfall_72h_mm
candidate_features.real_time_source: IMD/CWC River Basin Spatial Weather Grids
candidate_features.derivation: Spatially averaged 3-day precipitation across the entire upstream catchment basin polygon

candidate_features.name: hand_m
candidate_features.historical_source: Copernicus GLO-30 DEM + CWC/HydroSHEDS River Centerlines
candidate_features.real_time_source: Pre-indexed static 2D HAND raster lookup by road segment GPS coordinate
candidate_features.derivation: Height Above Nearest Drainage: z_road_centroid minus z_nearest_drainage_reach

excluded_geographic_proxies.name: road_length_m
excluded_geographic_proxies.reason: 100% unique float per segment; acts as a direct surrogate for road identity, causing severe spatial memorization.

excluded_geographic_proxies.name: road_type
excluded_geographic_proxies.reason: Phase 14 proved road_type=collector was responsible for 4 of 5 unseen-road false positives and is geographically clustered.

excluded_geographic_proxies.name: road_surface
excluded_geographic_proxies.reason: Severely unbalanced (CC on only 1 road segment) and geographically confounded.

excluded_geographic_proxies.name: elevation_m
excluded_geographic_proxies.reason: Absolute sea-level elevation fails cross-basin transfer because floodplain base levels vary by hundreds of meters across basins.
